summary: Clone a Response while teeing body bytes/stream and preserving response metadata.

semantics.body: teed into two branches when non-null
semantics.unusable: throws TypeError if body is disturbed or locked

tests.name: clone body independent branches
tests.input: const r=new Response("x"); const c=r.clone(); console.log((await r.text())+(await c.text()));

tests.name: used response cannot be cloned
tests.input: const r=new Response("x"); await r.text(); try { r.clone(); } catch(e) { console.log(e.name); }
